description: This file defines a PHP class 'BuzzModuleStatusChangeSubscriber' which subscribes to module status change events, specifically handling status changes for the 'buzz' module, and updates related permissions via service layer calls.

classes.name: BuzzModuleStatusChangeSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that listens for module status change events and updates permissions accordingly.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this class subscribes to.

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles the module status change event, updating permissions if the 'buzz' module is involved.
